title: El Agente Potente: High-Throughput Agentic Atomistic Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2609.14840v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundational machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are transforming atomistic simulations by achieving near-ab initio accuracy across large chemical spaces at a fraction of the computational cost. A central challenge in using these tools for high-throughput property calculations is translating high-level scientific intent into adaptive simulation campaigns without compromising workflow rigour. We introduce El Agente Potente, an agentic system that combines typed execution graphs with a complementary coding mode for MLIPs-driven atomistic simulations. Typed execution graphs provide structured and provenance-aware execution for standardized workflows, with large language models (LLMs) restricted to planning and routing while deterministic Python components perform scientific computation and validation. translated_title: El Agente Potente：高通量智能体原子尺度模拟
translated_abstract: 基础机器学习原子间势正在变革原子尺度模拟，它能够以极低的计算成本在大范围化学空间中实现接近从头算的精度。将这些工具用于高通量性质计算的一个核心挑战是：在不牺牲工作流程严谨性的前提下，将高层次的科学意图转化为自适应的模拟任务。我们提出了 El Agente Potente，这是一个智能体系统，它将类型化执行图与互补的编码模式相结合，用于由机器学习原子间势驱动的原子尺度模拟。类型化执行图为标准化工作流程提供了结构化且具备溯源能力的执行方式，其中大型语言模型仅负责规划与路由，而确定性的 Python 组件则负责执行科学计算与验证。作为对这种结构化执行的补充，一个编码智能体可以为需要更高程序灵活性的任务构建定制化的工作流。
tldr: 提出 El Agente Potente 智能体系统，通过将类型化执行图与编码智能体相结合，在保持工作流严谨性的同时实现了由机器学习原子间势驱动的高通量原子尺度模拟。
en_tdlr: El Agente Potente is an agentic system that combines typed execution graphs with a coding agent to enable high-throughput MLIP-driven atomistic simulations without compromising workflow rigor.
